title: 033 · Frame by Frame standalone square launch film
provenance: The standalone reference contains the same eight-shot Frame by Frame film shown on the right in case 010. Its already independently authored scene functions are reused in a dedicated 1080-square project, with separate reference evidence/export. All UI/wallpaper/marks/cards/glass/wordmark are Canvas geometry; no source video or texture asset is loaded.

panels.prompt: Make a launch video for my app

editable: Product/pill/wordmark, prompt, feature names, orbit colors, typography/palette and scene cut frames.
fidelity: Complete observed standalone eight-shot film. Independent typography, orbit shape/color, blur and glass approximations; not pixel identical.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
